findings.label: NeedsYouItem has no field for what a run was granted: it carries id, runId, botId, identity, question, options, createdAt, expiresAt, evidence, prompt, specFolder, answer and resumeRequestId, so an approval cannot say which app or secret it is approving.
The status index has six tables (meta, generations, runs, deliveries, items, retired) and none has a column for a grant, a secret name or an app.
runs carries summary as a NOT NULL text, so the activity feed's per-run line is already a single string the runner writes and a grant summary can ride there without a schema change.
DELIVERY_CHANNELS is ['desktop'] and desktop is the one channel that does not acknowledge, so the only delivery channel is the one that cannot confirm.

There is no memory anywhere in the runtime: a case-insensitive grep for memory across the skill matches only node_modules and one line of bots-author/SKILL.md, so memory today is the agent's context files and the spec-kit rather than a store.
RunRecord has nine top-level blocks and posture is the only one describing what the run was allowed to do, so apps and secretsUsed belong there and nowhere else.
FRONTMATTER_KEYS is a closed set of twelve keys and an unknown key is a hard refusal, so apps is a deliberate thirteenth entry rather than a free addition.
The git-hook trigger is opt-in and off by default, so a routine that starts on a pull request needs the repository to say so first.

Only one of the three stores needs a schema change: the needs-you item needs a grants field so an approval can name what it approves, while the secret store and connector registry ride in runs.summary and posture.
Memory is the part with no coupling at all because it does not exist, which is why it should be built last rather than first.

ruledOut.direction: a grants table in the status index
ruledOut.reason: the index is a projection of files and a grant is already in the run record, so a table would be a second source of truth for the same fact

ruledOut.direction: a new delivery channel for approvals
ruledOut.reason: desktop is the only channel and it does not acknowledge, so the honest move is to fix the acknowledgement rather than add a channel
it couples to nothing, so it can be added at any time and should be added last
